metas.name: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
metas.description: A paraplegic ex-jockey joins forces with an outlaw to compete in the first cross-continental horse race across North America in the 1800s.

metas.name: Half in the Bag
metas.description: Two VCR repairmen, Mike and Jay, scam an elderly man out of his fortune by discussing movies while on the job, and occasionally go on eccentric misadventures.

metas.name: Rick and Morty
metas.description: The fractured domestic lives of a nihilistic mad scientist and his anxious grandson are further complicated by their inter-dimensional misadventures.

metas.name: One Piece
metas.description: Monkey D. Luffy, a pirate with rubber powers, forms the Straw Hat crew and sails the Grand Line, battling rivals and the World Government on a quest for the legendary treasure One Piece and the title of Pirate King.

metas.name: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War
metas.description: The peace is suddenly broken when warning sirens blare through the Soul Society. Residents are disappearing without a trace and nobody knows who's behind it. Meanwhile, a darkness is approaching Ichigo and his friends in Karakura ...

metas.name: Clarkson's Farm
metas.description: Follow Jeremy Clarkson as he attempts to run a farm in the countryside.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: Five comedians are set tasks challenging their creativity and wit. The tasks are supervised by Alex Horne but the Taskmaster, Greg Davies, always has the final word.

metas.name: Critical Role
metas.description: A live weekly show in which a band of professional voice actors improvise, role-play, and roll their way through an epic Dungeons and Dragons campaign.

metas.name: The Pitt
metas.description: The daily lives of healthcare professionals in a Pittsburgh hospital as they juggle personal crises, workplace politics, and the emotional toll of treating critically ill patients, revealing the resilience required in their noble ...

metas.name: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
metas.description: Elf mage Frieren and her fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. But Frieren will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to understand what life means to the people arou...

metas.name: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia
metas.description: Five friends with big egos and small brains are the proprietors of an Irish pub in Philadelphia.

metas.name: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver
metas.description: Former Daily Show host and correspondent John Oliver brings his persona to this weekly news satire program.

metas.name: Black Sun
metas.description: A historical fiction drama and thriller set in the turbulent period of the late 1920s in the Balkans as a place where high politics, local interests, capital and crime all merge together.

metas.name: Kingdom
metas.description: In ancient China, a young boy dreams of becoming the greatest general of the Qin Kingdom.

metas.name: 30 for 30
metas.description: A collection of documentary films focused on sports.

metas.name: Ted Lasso
metas.description: American college football coach Ted Lasso is hired to manage AFC Richmond, a struggling English soccer club, and must win over skeptical players, staff, and fans.

metas.name: South Park
metas.description: The misadventures of four foul-mouthed, dirty-minded, irreverent grade-schoolers who live in the quiet, dysfunctional mountain town of South Park, Colorado.

metas.name: Invincible
metas.description: When 17-year-old Mark Grayson inherits superpowers, he becomes the superhero Invincible.

metas.name: Heated Rivalry
metas.description: Two rival hockey stars at the top of their game face an unexpected challenge when they develop feelings for each other, complicating their careers and the sport's expectations.

metas.name: X-Men '97
metas.description: A band of mutants use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them; they're challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.

metas.name: Are You Sure?!
metas.description: Whenever BTS's Jimin and Jung Kook meet, chaos and excitement ensue! In the summer of 2023, they embark on an unforgettable trip before their military enlistment. Their unpredictable adventure is full of surprises. Will Jimin and Jung Kook complete their journey safely?

metas.name: The Traitors UK
metas.description: Twenty-two strangers compete in a series of missions for a chance to win £120k. However, amongst the players lie the 'Traitors', who meet in secret and decide who to eliminate from their fellow players known as 'Faithfuls'.

metas.name: Stranger Things
metas.description: In 1980s Indiana, a group of young friends witness supernatural forces and secret government exploits. As they search for answers, the children unravel a series of extraordinary mysteries.

metas.name: Severance
metas.description: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

metas.name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
metas.description: A century before the events of "Game of Thrones," Ser Duncan the Tall, and his squire, Egg, wander through Westeros while the Targaryen dynasty rule the Iron Throne. Great destinies and enemies await the incomparable friends.

metas.name: One Punch Man
metas.description: The story of Saitama, a hero that does it just for fun & can defeat his enemies with a single punch.

metas.name: Call the Midwife
metas.description: Chronicles the lives of a group of midwives living in East London in the late 1950s to the early 1970s.

metas.name: QI
metas.description: A comedy panel game in which being Quite Interesting is more important than being right. Sandi Toksvig is joined each week by four comedians to share anecdotes and trivia, and maybe answer some questions as well.

metas.name: Primal
metas.description: A caveman and a dinosaur bond over unfortunate tragedies and become each other's only hope of survival in a treacherous world.

metas.name: All Creatures Great & Small
metas.description: James Herriot, fresh out of Glasgow Veterinary College, pursues his dream to become a vet in the Yorkshire Dales. He discovers that treating the animals is as much about treating their owners, and the Dales' farmers are a tough to...

metas.name: The Great British Baking Show
metas.description: Bakers attempt three challenges each week trying to impress the judges enough to go through to the next round and eventually are crowned Britain's best amateur baker.

metas.name: Shoresy
metas.description: Sees the foul-mouthed, chirp-serving, mother-loving, fan favorite character, Shoresy, join a senior AAA hockey team in Sudbury on a quest to never lose again.

metas.name: Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake
metas.description: Fionna, her best friend Cake and the former Ice King, Simon Petrikov, embark on an adventure through the multiverse, dodging new threats and making self-discoveries along the way.
